summary: Tool/function calling intermittently returns invalid JSON in tool_calls.arguments (streaming)
description:
Issue summary:
HelioPay reports their tool/function calling integration is failing because the model sometimes emits non-parseable JSON in `tool_calls[].arguments` when using streaming. Their JSON parser rejects trailing commas and unescaped newlines.

Impact:
Production incidents in HelioPay; tool router throws 500s and requests are retried.

Steps to reproduce (customer):
1) Use /v1/chat.completions with tools enabled and streaming=true
2) Ask for a transaction lookup tool call with a long prompt
3) Observe tool_calls.arguments occasionally contain `"amount": 12,}` (trailing comma) or multiline strings without escapes

Customer evidence (snip):
`tool_calls[0].arguments = {"account_id":"A-1092","start_date":"2025-02-01",}`

Notes:
Customer expects strict JSON per our docs; they are not able to switch to permissive parsing.
comments: Aisha Rahman (Support): Escalating. Customer says this started after 'Feb 10' runtime update. Looping in @Dev Patel + @Elliot Price. Slack thread: #support (ts 1739293321).

Dev Patel (Eng): Confirmed we can reproduce with streaming on and high temperature. Looks like partial chunks are being concatenated incorrectly when `tool_call` spans multiple deltas; sometimes we end up with an extra comma before closing brace.
Elliot Price (SRE): Checking deploy timeline. There was a canary of tool-calling serializer changes in us-east 02/10 23:00 UTC.
Dev Patel (Eng): Mitigation: disable 'aggressive delta coalescing' flag for tool-call arguments in us-east. Rolling back config now.
Aisha Rahman (Support): Customer confirms improvement after rollback; still saw one malformed payload in the last hour. Asking for ETA on full fix.
Dev Patel (Eng): Fix in progress: ensure arguments buffer is validated as JSON at end-of-tool-call and retry generation if invalid. Tracking follow-up in SUP-1860.
Aisha Rahman (Support): Closing as Resolved (workaround applied). Documenting known issue + workaround (strict JSON parsing) in Confluence.
